guidelines.detail: same as LRN-031 (The description requires writing a label and taking insurance only if necessary; the missing reference elements identify an inclusive split and join for these activities. This is already captured by learned guideline LRN-031.)

refines FID-03 (The generated gateway label refers to parcel insurance, while the description associates the decision with whether special shipping is necessary for large amounts; insurance is a separate qualified action. The records support a general rule for faithful gateway labels. This refines FID-03 by specifying how to keep gateway labels faithful when multiple conditions appear.)

refines FID-01 (The description states that the secretary invites companies to make offers and selects one, while the generated model adds an outside-participant pool and message flows that have no reference counterpart. This refines the general instruction to model stated participants and avoid inventing process facts by clarifying when outside organizations should be modeled as participants.)

same as LRN-006 (The description says packaging can happen in the meantime and the later activity waits until everything is ready. The records support the missing parallel start. The exclusive gateway recorded after packaging is not a suitable substitute for synchronization when all work must be complete.)

same as LRN-013 (The description makes preparation conditional on everything being ready, and the reference includes a gateway before that activity while the generated model has no counterpart. LRN-013 already covers using an exclusive gateway when a stated condition determines whether an action or path is needed.)

refines LANE-01 (The reference includes an organizational pool with work assigned to internal roles, while that pool has no generated counterpart (C1); the reference also assigns work to a warehouse role (C5). The description attributes activities to internal roles (S1, S5–S7). This adds an explicit pool requirement to the documented lane guidance. The generated task and gateway in C8 and C9 have description count)

The reference joins the packaging path and the shipping-arrangements path at an exclusive gateway (M1, F2, F4, F5), even though both must be ready before pickup preparation (S7). BPMN requires a parallel join for that synchronization, so the reference cannot support a guideline that reproduces this structure.

same as LRN-038 (The description makes amount size the condition for choosing the shipping path (S2), while the generated gateway label does not preserve that condition (P1). The guideline is already covered by learned guideline LRN-038.)

documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description states that normal post shipment is used in the small-amount case, but the generated task has no counterpart in the reference. Modeling a distinct described activity is already covered by FID-01; the more specific trigger highlights its application within an alternative branch. rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names multiple activities that must all occur and another activity that occurs only in certain cases as part of the same stage: Model the required activities and the conditional activity so synchronization waits for all required work but only for conditional branches that were activated; use an inclusive split and join rather than a parallel join that waits for every possible branch.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one activity is required while another activity in the same stage occurs only if a condition holds

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states distinct conditions for different decisions or qualifies an activity separately from a decision: Label each BPMN gateway with the condition it actually represents; do not transfer a condition from a separate decision or activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states distinct conditions for different decisions or qualifies an activity separately from a decision

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an internal role solicits offers from outside organizations and chooses among them: Model the stated solicitation and selection work in the internal process. Do not add separate participant pools or message flows for the outside organizations unless the description establishes them as process participants exchanging messages.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an internal role solicits offers from outside organizations and chooses among them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that required activities can proceed independently and that a later activity depends on all of them being complete.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a condition determines whether an action or process path is needed: model the choice with an exclusive gateway and conditional branches for the possible outcomes.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description makes an activity conditional on a stated readiness condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns activities in one organizational process to multiple internal roles: Represent the organization’s process in one participant pool and use lanes for the stated internal roles; do not omit the process pool or model ordinary internal roles as separate pools.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns activities in one organizational process to multiple internal roles

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a particular activity is performed in one of the alternative cases
